instagram.caption: 🚣‍♂️ Dive into the heartbeat of Dhaka’s waterways! 🌊 Our new short film 'River Rhythms Dhaka' follows a day in the life of river families—where folklore meets city pulse. Feel the flow, live the story. 🎬✨

linkedin.caption: We are excited to announce the release of 'River Rhythms Dhaka,' a short animated film that explores the cultural and social significance of Dhaka’s waterways for young festival audiences. The project blends traditional folklore with contemporary urban narratives, highlighting how the river shapes community, creativity, and ambition. Discover the heartbeat of the city through immersive animation.

x.caption: Experience Dhaka’s river life in a vibrant animated short—where folklore meets city rhythm. Feel the flow, live the story. #RiverRhythms

facebook.caption: Hey festival friends! 🎉 We're thrilled to launch 'River Rhythms Dhaka,' a short animated journey that takes you through a day on the river with Dhaka’s families. From playful splashes to heartfelt stories, discover how the water shapes our dreams. Join us and ride the currents of imagination!
